title: Keep the dev paper baseline Taiwan symbol fresh before any Taiwan persona exists

incident.deadlock_summary: After switching dev paper baseline to Taiwan (2330.TW), deploy run 37743441701 (867e829ca, 2026-10-08 07:59Z) passed 'Deploy dev VM stack' and failed 'Ensure governed dev paper baseline under lease'. The persona_provisioning row for persona-f10a7bde4eea7c6ee79e (request market TW, symbols [2330.TW], strategy_family dev_paper_baseline) failed with PERSONA_PROVISIONING_READBACK_FAILED (terminal_reason: 'runtime_binding_failed_or_mismatched,market_input_missing:max_age_seconds=86400'). The only Taiwan snapshot on hosted is a legacy 0050.TW snapshot (event_time 2026-10-02, no calendar evidence); none exists for 2330.TW. Meanwhile, resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols derived symbols only from active or market_input-paused paper RuntimeBindings; when no binding exists, the refresh skipped (operator run 37723717762 force=true logged 'bounded source refresh skipped: no_active_taiwan_symbols'). Because the baseline persona compensates before any binding stays paused, neither path ever fetched 2330.TW, creating a deadlock.

changes: Declared DEFAULT_MARKET_SYMBOL = '2330.TW' once in scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py and shared it with parse_args default and ensure_paper_baseline default, eliminating duplicate hard-coded symbol declarations.

Updated resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh to import DEFAULT_MARKET_SYMBOL from scripts.bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline, allowing PANTHEON_DEV_PAPER_BASELINE_SYMBOL override and falling back to DEFAULT_MARKET_SYMBOL.

If runtime_bindings.json does not exist or has no active/paused bindings, resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols returns the baseline symbol (2330.TW), preventing 'no_active_taiwan_symbols' skip when starting a fresh dev VM without existing personas.

When paper Taiwan bindings exist, resolve_bounded_source_refresh_active_symbols returns the union of the active/market-input-paused symbols and the baseline symbol without duplicates, preserving binding symbol order before the baseline symbol.

In dev, refresh no longer reports skipped no_active_taiwan_symbols when no binding exists. That skip remains only when a deployment explicitly declares no baseline symbol (PANTHEON_DEV_PAPER_BASELINE_SYMBOL='').
Maintained steady-service protections from DEV-TW-REFRESH-STEADY-SERVICES-20261008 unchanged; kept changes confined to symbol resolution without adding new refresh paths or flags.

tests.coverage: Unit and integration tests verify: (1) resolver with no bindings returns baseline symbol (2330.TW); (2) resolver with Taiwan bindings returns union without duplicates and preserves order before baseline symbol; (3) resolver with no baseline symbol declared returns empty string; (4) refresh-only path with no bindings runs bounded pull for baseline symbol (2330.TW); (5) refresh-only path with no baseline declared skips with no_active_taiwan_symbols; (6) bootstrap declared baseline symbol is shared as CLI default.
